$comment: Perf budgets for the M0 reference scenes (plan §10, ADR-0007). Draw calls include the colour pass, the moon shadow pass, the G-buffer for line art and character outlines. Frame time is measured under SwiftShader in CI, hence the generous ceiling. market-tpp (M2): the Targ district streamed in, Shinsekai streamed out; measured 182 draw calls / 80 active meshes. ADR-0021 (fire escape, balcony, three ladders and roof parapets on the south row): measured 248 draw calls / 109 active meshes. docks (ADR-0024): east end of the quay looking west (water and mist, crane, office), the docks yard and quay streamed in and nothing else; measured 190 draw calls / 82 active meshes.
